answer: A bond of 47% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in ripple, and terrace reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 165 aliases, and each one needs its own funded sonnet account. Repeating the trick 55 times costs 5 separate deposits and 38 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
